query: SELECT c.id, p.mentor_id FROM candidate c JOIN candidate p ON p.crawl_id = c.crawl_id AND p.mentor_id IS NOT NULL WHERE c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(c.emails) a JOIN json_each(p.emails) b ON a.value = b.value COLLATE NOCASE) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_profile a JOIN candidate_profile b ON a.crawl_id = b.crawl_id AND a.url = b.url WHERE a.candidate_id = c.id AND b.candidate_id = p.id))
